title: PR tool relocation and global discoverability

completion_criteria.text: MSP-1: models learn the centralized PR tool BEFORE hitting the gate - CLAUDE.md bullet plus a globally-visible self-triggering pr skill
MSP-2: PR tool relocated out of the mitosis lib to a neutral path, gate selfwrap updated atomically, no shim at the old path
Both MSPs shipped as stacked PRs, each independently correct, CI green, merged
Close the CRITICAL gate bypass by structurally rewriting block-destructive-bash.sh to parse-then-decide-per-command against the 12 invariants; regex patching cannot reach INV-3 or INV-4
Fix the boundary-regex false-positive and its twin false-negative uniformly across BOTH deny branches, inside the c4 rewrite; the merge branch stays unexempted per decision 0246
Close the deployed-copy premise as falsified, and document the real gap instead: new TOP-LEVEL files under .claude/hooks or .claude/rules stay dark until the Stow installer reruns
Fix basename-keying in no-self-merge-consent.test.mjs by pairing prefix and dir as the sibling scanners do

spine.active_goal: Get a bash gate that can be trusted. The c4 rewrite failed independent verification with multiple CRITICALs and six regressions against HEAD, so revert, fix forward or redesign must now be decided.
spine.next_step: FRESH SESSION. FIRST explain, in plain words for a reader with minimal domain knowledge, what is blocking this thread: what this hook guards, why it was rewritten, what two independent reviewers found, and the central tension - the rewrite is weaker than HEAD on six paths yet closes one CRITICAL that HEAD still has. THEN STOP and WAIT for specific instructions. Do NOT commit, do NOT open the PR, do NOT start a fix round. Full findings are in this thread's latest session log.
spine.last_session: Two independent reviewers both returned BLOCK on disjoint evidence, and a direct old-versus-new measurement found six paths where the rewrite is weaker than HEAD.

open_risks.text: Do not commit this branch or open its PR until the gate outcome is decided — two independent reviewers returned BLOCK, and the rewritten hook currently allows the merge and file-exfiltration paths it is meant to be the only guard for

Reverting the working-tree hook to HEAD is a trade, not a free rollback — it restores six denies the rewrite lost but reopens the newline-laundering CRITICAL the rewrite closed, and the hook is live by symlink so the choice takes effect immediately

Do not answer this with a sixth finding-list fix round — five prior rounds each closed a finding and opened a new one, and both reviewers named the same shape again: enumerated token equality where a normalizing decision was needed

A revert does not close the worst holes, because they predate this branch — attached -f body=@path exfiltration, /graphql endpoints, git checkout of the hook and perl -pi of the hook are allowed by BOTH the old and the new gate, at HEAD and on main

Add the missing invariant-coverage artifact before any PR from this branch — CI fails every pull request that adds no file under the coverage directory, and each file needs a verdict row for all twelve registry ids

The approved permissions.allow narrowing does not achieve what it was for — these are prefix rules, so node --test admits any path, node .claude/ admits traversal, every rule admits an arbitrary suffix, and git checkout of the hook stays ungated end to end

Stage only the permissions.allow hunk from settings.json — that file also carries unrelated user edits to model, effortLevel and plugin entries that must not be swept into this change; the hunk applies cleanly on its own
Do not attribute the one npm test failure to this work — it reproduces on pristine main and is caused by the home settings.json no longer resolving out of the home tree

Confirm the threatened M3 and M4 verdicts on PR #39 or schedule the missing tests — nothing asserts that the CLAUDE.md pull-request bullet or the pr skill file exists, so a regression in the guidance steering models to the centralized tool would be silent in CI

key_decisions.title: Relocate the PR tool to .claude/lib/git/pr.mjs with no shim at the old path
Teach the PR tool through a global skill and a CLAUDE.md bullet, keeping the gate as backstop
Rewrite the bash gate to parse-then-decide-per-command rather than patch its regexes
Leave the merge deny branch without a selfwrap exemption
Close the deployed-lib-copies follow-up as false and document the Stow unfolding gap instead

out_of_scope: A Windows-path PreToolUse hook that fails on darwin in a separate private repo - surfaced from the original error output, enforcing nothing there, never in scope for this thread
Renaming .claude/lib/superpowers-parallel itself - the directory name is still a fossil, but only the PR tool needed to leave it
The ~/.claude/settings.json symlink drift behind the protect-claude-config failure - it belongs to the permission-config-audit thread, and changing live settings is the user's call
Stale ground truth in the 2026-07-29 install-pin-safeguards spec (records 10 depth-1 entries, live is 9; ~/.claude/state now exists) - that spec is unimplemented and on another thread
